hosts.title: From inspiration to booking, step by step.
hosts.intro: Planning a wedding, a birthday or a company event? Here's how it works from the first idea to the day itself.

inspiration.title: Find your inspiration
inspiration.body: Start with ideas. Scroll the Explore feed to see real work from vendors on Vendora.
points: Filter by category, from photography to catering
Save the vendors you love with the heart

meet.title: Meet your vendors
meet.body: Narrow it down. Search by what you need, where your event is and your date.
points: Pick your date to hide vendors who are booked

conversation.title: Start the conversation
conversation.body: Open a vendor's profile and send an inquiry with your date and a few details.
points: Tell them about your event in one message
Ask questions and get a custom quote

plan.title: Plan in one place
plan.body: Keep track of each event you're planning, next to your conversations with vendors.
points: Add each event with its date and guest count
Keep the location and your notes together
Every inquiry and reply in one inbox

book.title: Book with confidence
book.body: When you're ready, your vendor sends a proposal. Review it and sign it online, then arrange payment directly with your vendor.
points: Proposals and contracts you can sign online
Payment arranged directly with your vendor
Leave a review after your event

faq.title: A few things you might be wondering.

find.q: How do I find the right vendor?
find.a: Search <vendors>Vendors</vendors> by service, location and date, or scroll <explore>Explore</explore> for ideas. Open any profile to see their work, pricing and packages, and save the ones you like.

contact.q: How do I contact a vendor?
contact.a: Open the vendor's profile and tap Send Inquiry. Add your date and a few details about your event. Their reply comes to your inbox, where you can keep the conversation going.

checked.a: Every listing is reviewed by the Vendora team before it appears. Vendors who also verify their documents show a verified badge on their profile.

booking.a: Your vendor sends you a proposal, which you can review and sign online. Payment is arranged directly between you and your vendor: Vendora doesn't take payments from hosts at this time.

join.q: Can I join as a vendor?
join.a: Yes. <signup>Sign up as a vendor</signup>, create your listing and add your work. The Free plan includes one listing, and your listing goes live once it's approved.

other.a: Visit the <help>Help centre</help> or email <email>hello@eventvendora.com</email>. Real people read every message.
